Hi Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these open slots:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30

Would any of those work for you? If none do, tell me what suits you better and I'll see what I can move.

Best,
Sarah

Hi Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — let's take that one. I've put it on my calendar for next week; please add it to yours so we both have it.

See you then,
Professor Alvarez

Perfect, thank you — Monday 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar now. See you then.

Best,
Sarah
